claim: Claude Agent Skills use three-level progressive disclosure so unused Skill content costs zero tokens until accessed.
stance_target: Advanced Skill Sequences pillar — SOPs encoded as Agent Skills reduce context overhead at scale
scope_conditions: Claude API, Claude Code, claude.ai product surfaces as of Oct 2026 docs
quoted_support: This lightweight approach means you can install many Skills without context penalty: until a Skill is triggered, only its name and description occupy context.

claim: Executable scripts bundled in a Skill run via bash with only their output entering the model's context window, not the script code itself.
stance_target: Cost & Resource Optimization pillar — deterministic code execution reduces token spend vs. on-the-fly code generation
scope_conditions: Skills architecture across all Claude product surfaces
quoted_support: When Claude runs validate_form.py, the script's code never loads into the context window. Only its output... consumes tokens, which makes scripts far more efficient than having Claude generate equivalent code on the fly.

claim: Skills sourced from untrusted or external parties pose a documented security risk because they can direct an agent to misuse tools or exfiltrate data in ways that don't match the Skill's stated purpose.
stance_target: Zero-Hallucination & Quality Control pillar — adversarial review needed before trusting third-party Skills/SOPs in production
scope_conditions: Anthropic's own security guidance for Agent Skills
quoted_support: Skills give Claude new capabilities through instructions and code, which also means a malicious Skill can direct Claude to invoke tools or execute code in ways that don't match the Skill's stated purpose.

claim: Custom Skills do not sync across Claude product surfaces (claude.ai, API, Claude Code), requiring separate upload/management per surface.
stance_target: Infrastructure/operational constraints of multi-agent Skill deployment
quoted_support: Custom Skills do not sync across surfaces. Skills uploaded to one surface are not automatically available on others.

claim: Claude API Skills run in a sandboxed container with no network access and no runtime package installation, constraining what agentic workflows can do server-side.
stance_target: Triggers/Infrastructure pillar — isolated cloud sandbox design constraints
quoted_support: Skills on the API run in a sandboxed container with no network access and no runtime package installation.

claim: Claude Enterprise organizations can enable Skill content scanning for custom Skills uploaded via claude.ai/Cowork, but this scanning does not cover Skills uploaded through the Skills API or Console.
stance_target: Zero-Hallucination & Quality Control pillar — existing vendor tooling for adversarial review has coverage gaps
quoted_support: Claude Enterprise organizations can also turn on Skill content scanning for custom Skills uploaded in claude.ai and Claude Cowork. Scanning doesn't cover Skills uploaded through the Skills API or the Claude Console.
